text: うんどう　ぶそくの　ねーちゃんを　ひっぱって　きたんだ

structure.jp: うんどう　ぶそくの　ねーちゃんを
ひっぱって　きたんだ

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる means doing something and coming here. ひっぱって　きた = 'dragged her along here'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the spoken form of のだ and makes the sentence an explanation of the situation. ひっぱって　きたんだ = 'you see, I dragged her here'.
